proved_locally: the broad service_role loses direct table reads and all raw R65 function entry points
a NOLOGIN crypto-writer role can call only authorised registration
a NOLOGIN deletion-worker role can call only authorised lease and destruction
authority spend and underlying R65 operation share one transaction
an underlying failure rolls back the spend so a corrected exact retry can proceed
an exact successful replay converges while changed token or binding conflicts
workspace, receipt, handle, provider and operation fields are checked against database state
authority-spend rows contain no provider handle, ciphertext or envelope
provider-specific destruction reason and fact bindings are enforced

database_proves: exact authority shape and five-minute validity
database_does_not_prove: the declared envelope SHA-256 was calculated from the supplied envelope
a production runtime can assume either NOLOGIN role safely

bounded_claim: R67 proves atomic, content-free authority spend and database grant separation in one local PostgreSQL process. It does not prove signature verification in PostgreSQL, production role assumption, multi-connection exclusion or provider behavior.
next_gate: Define and prove a production-safe runtime identity mapping for the two NOLOGIN roles, then run the lease and spend race through independent PostgreSQL connections.
